propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is principle-agnostic but implementation-locked to Anthropic, with hardcoded provider-name string matching at multiple decision points that prevents Bedrock and OpenAI-compatible endpoints from working

Bedrock-hosted Claude is unavailable as a first-class provider despite being clients' primary access path; only OpenAI-compatible gateway workarounds exist today, losing prompt caching, structured output, and retrying guarantees
documented env vars REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL and REBAR_LLM_API_KEY are rejected at runtime by _pai_check_config rather than composing with model_provider to enable best-effort OpenAI-compatible routing

LLM verdict sidecars record only an opaque model string with no provider, endpoint, tier, or capability provenance, making it impossible for consumers to distinguish first-class from best-effort verdicts or debug routing failures

prompt caching, structured output mode selection, and retry/timeout configuration all depend on provider-name string matching rather than pydantic-ai's provider_factory and ModelProfile extension points, blocking clean multi-provider composition
